stable.label: genesis-foundation-materials-0.3-integrated
stable.note: Matter Lab 0.6, Materials 0.1, Materials 0.2 and the Materials 0.3 true-volume C++/WebAssembly candidate are integrated through CI-green pull requests. Overall product remains unverified because the deployed /volume3d/ WebGPU runtime, sustained target-device performance and real iPhone Safari behavior have not yet been independently exercised.

ci.simulation_test: PASS genesis matter 0.6 cooperative self-assembly tests
PASS genesis materials 0.1 granular sand/water tests

materials3d_lab.representation: 2.5D x/z heightfield rendered as perspective 3D geometry

volume3d_lab.representation: Genuine x/y/z coarse voxel volume; not a heightfield

ci.native_test: PASS genesis materials 0.3 native C++ volumetric tests
ci.wasm_test: PASS genesis materials 0.3 versioned browser + compiled WebAssembly tests

failures_learned.cause: Freestanding wasm32 link required explicit memory primitives after LLVM optimized clearing loops to memset
failures_learned.repair: Provide tiny freestanding memset/memcpy and keep compile regression in CI

failures_learned.cause: Initial committed browser WASM payload was malformed/truncated while fresh CI-compiled WASM was valid
failures_learned.repair: Use versioned solver.v1.wasm.b64 generated from the verified 10,599-byte CI module and compare semantics/hash in CI

active_objective: Independently exercise the deployed /volume3d/ C++/WebAssembly + WebGPU route, capture actual runtime backend/errors and performance, and repair any live failure before adding another major graphics, material or biological subsystem.
next_gate: Live/runtime validation of /volume3d/: confirm the versioned WebAssembly payload loads, WebGPU shader/pipelines compile and render non-black state, interaction works, and capture target-device performance. Do not infer live WebGPU, iPhone, photorealism or evolution success from CI.
invariants: ChatGPT cannot self-certify its own changes
No critical project fact may live only in chat memory
Prototype experiments do not become product without a productionization gate
Tyler is not the build system or log courier
UNKNOWN must never silently become PASS
CI PASS does not imply live deployment PASS or iPhone PASS
Rendering consumes simulation state and must not secretly become simulation logic
Materials 0.3 is genuine x/y/z coarse volume state and must not be described as a heightfield
A coarse voxel must not be described as a literal individual sand grain
State-derived grain presentation must not be described as extra simulated particles
Phenomenological wet cohesion must not be described as validated capillary or geotechnical physics
Volumetric water cell rules must not be described as Navier-Stokes/SPH/MPM/FLIP
Biological evolution is not built and must not be faked with predefined creatures
Unreal-quality is an experiential target, not a verification status
Matter Lab 0.6, Materials 0.1 and Materials 0.2 remain independently available
